ctaHeading: Yarraville's landscapers are ready — let's grow your garden.
aboutText: The Green Project has been serving Yarraville for over 10 years, specialising in sustainable garden design and maintenance. Our team of experts is dedicated to creating beautiful, eco-friendly outdoor spaces. We use local plants and water-efficient systems to ensure your garden thrives throughout the year. Located on Geelong Rd, we're your neighbours committed to green living.
servicesText: We offer comprehensive landscaping services tailored to Yarraville homes and businesses. From initial garden design to regular maintenance, our team handles it all with a focus on sustainability.

services.title: Garden Design
services.desc: We create custom garden designs that reflect your style and the local Yarraville environment.

services.title: Lawn Care
services.desc: Professional lawn mowing, fertilising, and weed control to keep your grass healthy and green.

services.title: Planting & Garden Beds
services.desc: Expert selection and planting of native and exotic species for vibrant, low-maintenance gardens.

services.title: Irrigation Systems
services.desc: Installation and maintenance of water-efficient irrigation to conserve resources and save you money.

services.title: Hardscaping
services.desc: We design and build pathways, patios, and retaining walls to complement your garden.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep including pruning, mulching, and seasonal clean-ups for a tidy outdoor space.
